metadata.case_name: SIU WAI YEE v. LAU SIN HANG

plaintiff.occupation_before: Ran market stalls at the Shek Wai Kok market as sole proprietor selling fruits, vegetables and flowers
plaintiff.occupation_after: Sole proprietor running market stalls (intends to continue running her business as sole proprietor)
plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: Sole proprietor running market stalls (intends to continue running her business as sole proprietor)

source: She had a fracture of the left acetabulum and an extensive wound with severe soft tissue degloving to the left thigh.
The left fracture acetabulum healed with mild irregularity on the acetabular side of the joint.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of acetabulum without disruption of pelvic ring

injuries.description: an extensive wound with severe soft tissue degloving to the left thigh
source: She had a fracture of the left acetabulum and an extensive wound with severe soft tissue degloving to the left thigh.
anterior, medial and lateral aspects of left thigh upper 2/3 covered by split thickness skin graft, mature of 29 cm by 30 cm, mild to moderately hypertrophic and decreased sensation;
injuries.icd_description: Other specified open wound of hip or thigh

source: There was also a loss of proximal quadriceps muscle, scar at this site was tethered down to muscle.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injury of quadriceps muscle or tendon

injuries.description: right pubic rami fracture healed with slight mal-alignment
source: X-ray examination showed right pubic rami fracture healed with slight mal-alignment.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of pubis without disruption of pelvic ring

injuries.description: extensive scarring and contour deformity including left lower abdominal scar of rectangular shape 17 cm by 11 cm; split thickness skin graft of left thigh 29 cm by 30 cm; right thigh anterior aspect skin graft donor site of 25 cm by 23 cm
injuries.body_part: left lower abdomen; left thigh; right thigh donor site
source: (a) left lower abdominal scar of rectangular shape 17 cm by 11 cm , pigmented and non-hypertrophic;
(b) anterior, medial and lateral aspects of left thigh upper 2/3 covered by split thickness skin graft, mature of 29 cm by 30 cm, mild to moderately hypertrophic and decreased sensation; and
(c) on right thigh anterior aspect skin graft donor site of 25 cm by 23 cm non-hypertrophic.
Dr Walter King ... was of the opinion that the scars to the left lower abdomen and contour deformity to the left anterior thigh were permanent.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the hip or thigh

manifestations.description: unable to carry heavy objects because of her left buttock pain after heavy exertion
swelling of her left leg and foot after prolonged standing
decreased sensation in split thickness skin graft area of left thigh
tenderness at anterior superior iliac spines and left sacro-iliac joint
slight loss of hip flexion and muscle wasting at the left thigh girth
mild decrease of hip flexion and knee extension power
walking gait was normal (but not able to squat down)

treatments_received: operation at the Kwong Wah Hospital (pin inserted at upper leg level)
skeletal traction in bed for over 70 days
8 repeated operations of debridement of thigh wound

losses.category: Loss of sexual function and sexual life
losses.description: Marital life gradually deteriorated after the accident; recently there has not been any sexual relationship with her husband.

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: May have difficulty carrying and lifting heavy objects, unable to squat and experiences swelling after prolonged standing affecting ability to carry out market stall work.
